Smart fetch kạmi bạṛić len khan se keybox ạḍi alga tege bodol len khan beohar hoyoḱ kana.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ḍahar: menak̕ Remote Key Provisioning mo̠ḍul ko̠ biḍạueda, TEE sạbit sạbit ạri-cạli ko̠ biḍạueda, ar KmInstallKeybox kạmiạkoak̕ ạri-cạli ko̠ so̠do̠ra. Cet́ hõ baṅ bodol akana — mit́ṭen sadharọn ḍibhiṭ sṭeṭas ńel.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine kạmi (eken paṛhaoḱ): ḍampis khon Widevine ḍher kạmi lạgit́ kạmi kạmi, DRM (IDM) key-fail reaḱ jạruṛ, ar ona são joṛao akan sisṭom reaḱ gunko uduga. Modify do̠ cet̕ hõ̠ baṅ kana.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP thik: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manyual chalao kana. Aṭomatik pas bạṛic̕ lenkhan attesṭeṭ reak̕ kạmi thik hoyok̕a. Joto run re mit̕ṭen sạri jitạu/bạṛic̕ line chapa hoyok̕ kana.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Purạ RKP thik: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh purạ calaoeda. Hard case ko handle ho jayega ar dher somoy lagao huyu aa. Mucạt́re mit́ṭen sạri jo ńeloḱ kana.
strings.mdGmsReset: • GMS reset: Play Store ar Google se̠rvice (GMS+GSF) reaḱ data sạbit kate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate ạḍi usạrate. Eken jidḍhi sạbit lạgit́ — ona do̠ tis hõ amaḱ photo se file do̠ bae joṭet́a.
strings.mdCertify: • Khel sạbit: ḍibhiṭ reaḱ RKP sạbit sạbit ạt ńel ar jạruṛ khan sạbit ạidạri reaḱ gunko do̠ arhõe seṭet́a. Beoharkoak̕ data do̠ baṅ joṭet̕a.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER kạmi: ḍihạṭ sạbit são joṛao akan Google se̠rvice ḍạr (SOTER) reaḱ kạmi ko thik akada. Aema jinis lạgit́ beohar hoyoḱ kana oka do̠ pạhil kạmi lạgit́ SOTER re pạtiạuḱ kana.
strings.mdPifApply: • PIF laṛcaṛ: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh ạḍi daṛe calao. Bachao akan kạṭup̕ hạṭiń (sthaniy/bạṛti) laṛcaṛ ar pif.prop/pif.json file ko ạḍi jạruṛa. Log re mit̕ṭen sạri jo̠ ńelok̕ kana.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF chek: sthao akan injin reak̕ ạt, kạṭup̕ reak̕ kạmi (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ar kạmi reak̕ kạmi kạmi ko so̠do̠ra. Eken check — ona do cet ho bae modification eda.
strings.mdCanary: • Kēnāri āpḍēṭa: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -mē lāgida. Ạḍi jạruṛan RKP pạrman (2026 phọrwari) sãote̱ jọpọṛao lạgit te̱ nawa kanari injin jọpọṛao hatao et’ kana.
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Injin ḍahar: TrickyStoreOSS ạt (pid, log), chabi boks reaḱ file (akṭiv vs beoharko), asli vs sạpạṛiạ jinis reaḱ kạṭuć hạṭiń, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP chabi ko nạmuna. Eken ḍahar ḍahar kạmi.
strings.hintKbSlots: Moḍul do̠ bar keybox slọṭ ko̠ be̠nao̠et́ kana: pạhil (po̠no̠t, tis hõ̠ baṅ mọhọr) ar dosar (be̠kaup). Noa tab do̠ oka slot kạmi kana, pạtiạu bo̠do̠l, se̠ sạri nehor re̠ se̠ko̠ndạr khon pạhil hạbić uskur — backup ar purạ log sãote̠.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity ḍahar: TEE chapa ạgu, chapa dokan2 bhitri re laybreri injekṭion, bạtil reaḱ sạjại (CRL), rukhiạ-suci reaḱ ḍahar ar RKP sạjại reaḱ ḍahar ko ḍahar ạguet́ kana. Eken paṛhaoḱ — ona do cet́ hõ bae bodol daṛeaḱa.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slot: pạhil ar dosar slot reaḱ ạt ko uduga ar ona talare jạruṛaḱ ko bodol daṛeaḱa. Primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) do̠ jaoge̠ kạmi lạgit́ te̠ ạḍi jạruṛa ar tis hõ̠ baṅ wipe hoyoḱa. Secondary khon prathamik hạbić ạḍi jạruṛa.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml do̠ pạhil slo̠ṭ reaḱ jinis hoyoḱa.
• Nit́ reaḱ pạhil do̠ bo̠do̠l lahare̠ backup lekate̠ bańcao̠ḱa.
• Ce̠t́ hõ baṅ ḍe̠leṭ akana — kạmi do̠ ạḍi jạruṛa.5#0#00.
